feature.title: Inkling explainers inside every chapter
feature.problem: Chapters explain each idea in words, with at most one movie and the code-drawn 'Your map so far'. The owner wants every chapter to carry a hand-drawn explainer made with Inkling (~/Projects/inkling, their own library: text in, a hand-made drawing out that draws itself step by step), placed inline where it helps, chosen to fit the idea (sequence for a protocol, cycle for a loop, compare for two approaches, timeline, stack, mind map, flow) and never one fixed template. New courses get them from the builder and from agents writing through the MCP; the harness course gets them now as a trial before the other five.
nonGoals: Backfilling the other five courses: after the owner has looked at the harness course.
Replacing 'Your map so far' (kept as it is) or Flowmovie movies.
Editing explainers in the app; they are written by the builder or an authoring agent.

surfaces.name: Chapter (desktop app)

moments.peak: reaching the explainer right after the paragraph it pictures, and watching it draw the idea step by step
moments.end: the drawing finished in place, its caption saying the idea in one line, and the text carrying on below it

surfaces.purpose: Read the chapter with its explainer where it helps, not in a section at the end.

fields.label: Explainer
fields.value: Inkling card: title, drawing, play bar

fields.label: Play
fields.value: draws on first view; step through with the bar

fields.label: Alt
fields.value: the diagram's title and step captions

states.loading: A box the drawing's height with its title, while the Inkling module loads (about 36 KB gzipped, only on chapters that have one).
states.empty: A chapter with no explainer renders as today.
states.error: An explainer that fails to parse shows its title and 'This drawing has a mistake, so here is its text' with the source; the chapter still reads.
states.success: The drawing appears inline, draws itself the first time it scrolls into view (not under reduced motion), and the play bar steps through it.

components.why: inline placement with no new schema: the text carries the drawing at the right spot, the builder, the MCP and authors all write the same thing, and the reader and desktop split on it
components.rejected: a separate diagrams row with an anchor (two sources of truth for one position)

components.control: Vendored Inkling build (vendor/inkling via npm run vendor), loaded lazily
components.why: the owner's own library, self-contained (rough.js and dagre bundled); lazy so chapters without one pay nothing
components.rejected: a git dependency (Docker builds need it offline) and the CDN (private tailnet)

components.control: Paper chosen by the app's theme, overriding the source
components.why: one look per reading theme; the builder writes content, not styling
components.rejected: letting each explainer pick its own paper

components.control: The reader's markdown parser emits an 'inkling' block for the fence
components.why: same pattern as code blocks; the reader already owns its block renderer

endpoints.purpose: start a background job that adds explainers to an existing course (the harness course now); returns jobId, progress like a build
